adds.title: Governor Stitt Executive Order - Definition of legal sex (August 2023)
adds.summary: On August 1, 2023, Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt signed an executive order requiring state agencies to define female, woman, girl and mother as a person whose biological reproductive system is designed to produce ova and male, man, boy and father as a person whose biological reproductive system is designed to fertilize the ova of a female based on sex assigned at birth, restricting legal recognition of transgender people for state agency purposes including women's spaces.
